description: This file defines actions and handlers related to Zalo messaging within a plugin system. It includes functions for listing enabled Zalo accounts, describing message tools, extracting tool send data, and handling send actions for Zalo messages. The file imports runtime creation functions, account resolution utilities, and other SDK components specific to the plugin framework, and exports a main object implementing the ChannelMessageActionAdapter interface for Zalo.

methods.name: function listEnabledAccounts(cfg: OpenClawConfig, accountId?: string | null) { listEnabledAccounts
methods.description: Lists enabled Zalo accounts, resolving specific account if accountId is provided, or listing all enabled Zalo accounts otherwise.

methods.name: describeMessageTool
methods.description: Provides descriptions of message tools available for the current configuration, returning capabilities if accounts are enabled.

methods.name: extractToolSend
methods.description: Extracts the send message action from arguments for processing.

methods.name: handleAction
methods.description: Handles the 'send' action to send a message via Zalo, including preparing parameters, invoking the runtime, and handling the result.

calls: sendMessageZalo(to ?? "", content ?? "", { accountId: accountId ?? undefined, mediaUrl: mediaUrl ?? undefined, cfg: cfg })
